verdict.rationale: Vast.ai ships an official CLI, Python SDK and REST API that cover the whole platform ("anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal"), and its docs explicitly recommend scoped API keys for CI/CD and automation. A runtime probe confirmed the CLI installs and runs non-interactively and that live marketplace search works, with JSON returned from the REST endpoint. missing for 10: no documented end-to-end CI pipeline example (e.g. a ready-made GitHub Actions workflow), and no hands-on corroboration of the authenticated instance lifecycle (create/destroy) run from CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Anything you can do in the web console, you can automate from your terminal.
For shared tooling, CI/CD, or automation, create a scoped key with only the permissions that workload needs.
The Vast.ai REST API gives you programmatic control over the entire platform.
the official Vast.ai CLI (pypi `vastai`) installed via uvx and ran keylessly — `vastai --help` prints the full command surface including search offers, create instance, and destroy instance.
